en.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Climbs to #2 All-Time Domestic Box Office
en.summary: The web-slinger's latest cinematic adventure continues its astonishing run, holding the top spot for a sixth consecutive weekend. It's now just shy of a legendary Marvel record.
en.body:
In a feat rarely seen in modern blockbusters, **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** has refused to swing out of the No. 1 position at the domestic box office, marking its sixth consecutive weekend at the top. This incredible staying power, coupled with a surprising lack of major competition, has propelled the film to staggering heights, placing it firmly in the conversation for one of the biggest movies of all time.

Over its sixth weekend, the film is estimated to have pulled in an impressive $23.3 million, bringing its domestic total to a colossal $855.2 million. This figure places it just a hair's breadth behind the monumental **Avengers: Endgame**, which currently holds the second-highest domestic gross at $858.3 million. The only film standing between **Brand New Day** and the all-time domestic championship is **Star Wars: The Force Awakens**, which reigns supreme with a massive $935.6 million.

The success of **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** is not just a win for Sony and Marvel; it's a significant boost for the entire 2026 box office. As of Sunday, the domestic box office has surpassed the $7 billion mark, a remarkable 20.4 percent increase over 2025's returns. Furthermore, this summer's slate of films has collectively earned an estimated $4.444 billion domestically, outperforming last year's tally by 25.5 percent, though it still trails the all-time summer record set in 2013.

## A Spider-Verse Phenomenon

The sheer tenacity of **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** at the box office speaks volumes about its connection with audiences. Holding the top spot for six weeks is an extraordinary accomplishment, underscoring a potent combination of critical acclaim, fan enthusiasm, and perhaps a touch of generational nostalgia. For cinephiles and casual moviegoers alike, this film has become a must-see event, sparking conversations and repeat viewings that continue to fuel its impressive financial trajectory. It’s a testament to the enduring power of this iconic character and the cinematic universe he inhabits.

## What's Next for the Web-Slinger?

With **Spider-Man: Brand New Day** so close to surpassing **Avengers: Endgame** for the second-highest domestic gross, all eyes are on whether it can achieve this milestone. The film's trajectory suggests it has a strong chance, though the final push will be crucial. Fans will be eagerly watching each weekend to see if Spidey can indeed climb even higher in the annals of box office history.
